_about: Hand-written. state: now (being built), next (planned), done (shipped; name the release).

items.title: Rust client
items.about: The TypeScript client's design in Rust: rows and operations generated from the API description, one query builder, keyed writes, events and watching. It passes the same shared cases as the TypeScript client.

items.title: Add-on events in the TypeScript client
items.about: Add-ons can send their own events since 0.7.7. The client will let an app listen for them by name, typed like the built-in ones.

items.title: Python client
items.about: A thin client for scripts and Python apps, generated from the same API description.

items.title: Faster review history
items.about: Review history answers sooner on large collections: about 0.94 s to 0.74 s for 280,000 reviews. `areDue` and `getIntervals` answer for cards that were never reviewed.

items.title: Faster field text
items.about: `fields[].text` converts only the fields a read names, and uses a field without HTML as it is. A filter on the text itself works.
